# Known load-dependent flakes (#2397)
#
# Each non-comment line is one ExUnit failure exactly as the runner prints it:
#   <Module> :: <test name>
#
# A red CI run's failing tests are compared against this list. A test on the
# list is reported as a KNOWN FLAKE (an existing investigation owns it); a test
# not on the list is reported as a NEW FAILURE and must be treated as a real
# regression from the change. That distinction is what keeps "CI is red"
# informative: red caused only by known flakes is a flake that fired, not proof
# the change is broken.
#
# Provenance: each entry records where it was last observed (run URL or commit,
# date) so stale entries can be audited and pruned once a flake stops firing.
# Update the list when a flake is fixed (remove the entry once it has not fired
# for several weeks) or when a new flake is confirmed (add the exact name
# printed by the runner). Keep entries byte-exact — the comparison is a
# full-line match.

# Quarantined for #2397: reads the configured repository through the shared
# WorkflowStore singleton, which can serve a stale valid config under load.
# Last observed run 32630000223 (2026-08-23).
